name: python-binary-search
title: Binary Minimum Spanning Tree
blurb: binary search over small sorted nonneg integer arrays: the index equals the shipped oracle (linear scan) on every seeded corpus, the middle is the pivot and the half that cannot hold the target is discarded, and a missing target answers -1; unsorted input is named, never searched.
default_description: A spanning-tree walker whose total is the enumeration oracle's minimum on every small undirected graph, whose witness ledger tells the truth, and whose tree spans every node exactly once.

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --python 3.12 --allow-existing && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

detect.contains: the middle is the pivot and the half that cannot hold the target
